title: New Map: Falling (CTF Based Jump Map)

posts.h:
WARNING: THIS MAP WILL MAKE YOU SMASH YOUR KEYBOARD!!1!

As the title says, I and a mate (Lhayze) have created this basic Jump Map. The idea of the map is to jump the map/capture the flag and return it in the quickest time possible.

Having come from a Trickjumping background (Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory). I basically apply this to every FPS game I play and try to come up with ways to "Trickjump" around. This was the first thing we thought about when we saw this game had a map editor, so as soon as I applied and got accepted, it's the first thing we done.

Currently, the best way to play this map is on CTF with wrench-only. I'm not sure if all the dying is linked to your score (if you don't finish the map) or even if you do finish it, it's something I need to confirm. Play at your own risk!

Here I present "Falling".
Server: Battle-EU
Gamemode: CTF/Jumping.
Size: 50x50.
Jumper: FlameMino

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=biDVWmReD80



The map contains two paths, both which are very similar (due to map limit/50x50 and not being able to make it even cause of the flag being 3x3, we had to make the blue path slightly shorter, because the flag was 1 block closer to the red side). Other then that, it's completely the same. This was a balance change in order to make it fair for both.

Below is a few screenshots of the route/most of the map:














The things I've noticed with these game physics so far is you can airturn without jumping (falling from a platform/turning in air after falling) This map will briefly show this. Also, certain heights you can get further just by running off the platform, rather than jumping.

It would be nice if they could implement a gamemode suited for jumping, where dying won't reflect your KDR, also a way to set a spawn in map testing so we can test each jump without having to restart the whole course, like a save/load position command + binds/custom keybindings. I know the game is primarily a FPS, but what’s wrong with expanding out to other styles?
Also a mode to diable time limit/keeping the capture the flag so that we don't have to reset every 7 minutes.

e: I just remembered, the video is done in the mapping sector in which you don't take fall damage. The map is still possible under CTF rules which includes fall damage, you just have to wait untill the speed reduced from falling wares off. Theres 2 sections where that happens. Just wait a little and you'll be fine.

Last but not least, I'd like to say thanks to our personal grasscutter Hellzor! Many thanks.

Thanks, and enjoy!

MAC'S MAPS
A collection of maps I have created for the community to enjoy.

Hallways
Gamemodes: TDM, Survival

Hallways is my first and simple TDM/Survival map which you can go around and blast people at close range. This map is also a good way to earn experience points fast. This map contains hallways that leads into the center crossroads from the spawn points. There is also a ventilation system above for an alternative means of getting around the map. Hallways recommends you to play this on Survival, as it you could get spawnkilled in a TDM game.

Train Raid
Gamemodes: TDM, Survival, CTF

Train Raid takes place on a train that has seven cars which extends as long as the map. Two teams from the opposite sides of the train go head to head either taking down each other, or fighting for the flag. The train has the Engine where blue team spawns from, blue and red flag points, two passenger cars, a cargo car (with the flag spawn), and the caboose where red team spawns from. The top of the caboose also has a spot for sniping and there are three turrets on top of the train cars.

title: Map that might never see the light of day! D:

posts.h:
Built a map on a 100x100 grid, Trimming it down to a 99x99, And removing ALL known unseen blocks. Map's still 14,768 or something thereabouts outside my publish limit tho. So decided I'd show it off here so at least it can be ogled. XD

ABOVEGROUND SPRAWL:



There USED to be two buildings separated by a small grassy lot where the huge ones are to the far left and right where the grassy fields are now, But I tried deleting them into grassy fields to save blocks. It didn't help. X3 The central tower is a sniper's nest that both team can have a blast fighting over as the map's controlling point, as it straddles not only the middle of the field, But the lower half of the undertunnels where the central flag is in CTF, And the two bomb zones are for demolition. There is a vulcan at each team's main base, On a terraced grassy hill with a suitable hilly wall directly opposite so the guns can be snuck up on and dealt with by the opposing side. Likewise, The roof of the sniping tower has two cannons placed to give overhead support, Forcing teams to make equal runs both above and underground.

UNDERHALLS:



This area is reachable from a garage entrance near both team's bases, And from the sniping tower's basement in the center. The few spawns down here for red and blue were built with making sure either team couldn't overpower th middle zone too early into a match. Likewise, The neutral flag and both demo zones are located close to eachother on the underhall level to prevent a team losing from focusing on the wrong bombzone for too long, but still just far enough apart to allow for some feint and dodge tactics. Plenty of cover on both the overland and underhalls means plenty of oppertunity to hop from cover to cover.

Hope it sounds good, And that I can upload it some day. If you ever see it in the buildrooms, It's called 'Lost Faith'

[TUTORIAL] How to post your map on the Brick-Force Wiki

posts.h:
This is a tutorial about how to post your map on the Brick-Force wiki.

This is an example of page this tutorial will learn you to make: http://www.brickforcewiki.com/KeiranCity

Step 1: Register an account.

Of course, you have to make an account to edit the wiki. Go on http://www.brickforcewiki.com and create your account.

Step 2: Upload your screenshoots.

You need use this link ( http://www.brickforcewiki.com/Special:Upload ) to upload your screenshoots from your computer, one by one. This may take a while, but you have to do it to be able to use these screenshoots for your page.

Step 3: Create the Page.

*Replace Blue Text by the right information.

To create your page, you need to use this link http://www.brickforcewiki.com/Name of your Map

Then, you should have this message: "There is currently no text in this page. You can search for this page title in other pages, search the related logs, or edit this page."

Click on "edit this page".

Step 4: Enter the code.

Now, copy/paste this code on the page and don't forget to replace the Blue Text by the right informations.

[[File:NAME OF SCREENSHOOT 1|500px|thumb|left]]

'''NAME''': NAME OF THE MAP

'''AUTHOR''': NAME OF THE AUTHOR

'''DETAILS''':

''MODES'': CTF/SURVIVAL/TEAM BATTLE/DEFUSION

''SIZE'': 50x50/100x100

''NORMAL BRICKS'': NUMBER OF NORMAL BRICKS

''SPECIAL BRICKS'': NUMBER OF SPECIALS BRICKS

''TOTAL BRICKS'': TOTAL NUMBER OF BRICKS

''TOTAL COST'': TOTAL COST IN POINTS

''TIME SPENT TO BUILD IT'': TIME SPENT TO BUILD IT

[[File:NAME OF SCREENSHOOT 2|500px|thumb|left]]

'''VIDEOS''' :

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iS0V3pLkA5M

--~~~~

[[File:NAME OF SCREENSHOOT 3|500px|thumb|left]]

[[File:NAME OF SCREENSHOOT 4|500px|thumb|left]]
Note 1: Feel free to edit this code to improve your page.
Note 2: Add more [[File:NAME OF THE SCREENSHOOT|500px|thumb|left]] at the end if you want more screenshoots.

Step 5: Add your link.

Go on this page http://www.brickforcewiki.com/Players_Maps and press edit.

Add -[[NAME OF THE MAP YOU WROTE IN THE LINK]] by AUTHOR.

title: NoMansLand, New Battlefield, 100x100, By Barzy & Plopah

posts.h:
Hi everybody!

NoMansLand is a huge battlefield, it's a balanced map thought to be suitable for all weapons.

If you play with a sniper you can take position in one of the different bunkers to have a view over the entire map.

If you prefer assault rifle, submachine, .... you can cross the battlefield in the trenches or underground without being snipe.

CTF: You appear in your bunker: reach the top of the bunker of the center to take the flag and plant him in the enemy base.

Team death match: You appear in your bunker: Eliminate your opponent, everything is permitted.

Demolition: You appear in your bunker: The red team must destroy the enemy entries of the underground and the blue team must stop them. Destroy/Protect the objectives or kill the enemy!

Survival: You appear in different positions of the map (bunkers/underground) : You are alone, kill everybody!

Travel over mountains or under them through the lost tombs that the dead rise again.

Modes
TDM: Choose your side, Red (Knights of Misery) or Blue (Legion of Despair) and join in the epic battle of the Lost Tomb. Your team must travel over the mountain or under it and counter the apposing force within the tomb.

CTF: The tower of the chosen holds the banner of your factions power, be the team to grab the banner and place it within your enemies lair. In this battle you must work as a team to archive your goal and become the masters of the lost Tomb.

Info:
Lost Tomb was created as my 3rd map registered by a group of great people, friends and I in just inside of 5 hours. Specian thanks goes out to MrFluffy for all the work. It is based around on the idea of two groups light and dark, fighting in an endless battle. Will you be the one to help defeat the enemy faction and gain control of the Lost Temple of Misery's Skull? The map is 2 levels above ground and below ground. I kept the tunnels simple in design with only 3 possible paths leading to each side and 3 paths connecting them for each side. Each temple was created equally and at the same distance from the flag if wishing to play ctf.

I will post my comments and feedback on The Chapel and The Bridge seeing i have yet to play the carbon copies maps.

The Chapel:
Pros: Visually well thought out, runs very smooth and navigates easy. Great for snipers and provides a great place to see the whole map from the chapel roof. Not completely a one direction map and offers places for the element of surprise. Spawn point 2nd floor isnt so high that if you jump from it you dont take fall damage.
Cons: Limited exits from staring location and not lots of cover other then trees when leaving. Snipers can pick you off from anywhere outside the chapel if on chapel roof.

The Bridge:
Pros: again a wonderful thought out map visually and navigation. Fun environment and gives a sense of realism when looking down the bridge. Allows for head to head straight forward firefights as your team pushes the bridge. Objects such as cars and buses provide cover and are well placed.
Cons: Limited paths and one directional map, with limited cover. The only flanking path offers no cover and is a fairly long distance to travel in the open.

Conclusion: Overall I enjoyed these maps a great deal and think anyone who hasnt tried them out should at least do so if seeing them listed in the channel. Very creative layout and I am looking forward to seeing more maps by the creator.

In playing this map I ran into a few complaints about the stairs, perhaps use a ramp in the middle a couple spaces wide so even though there are steps you will still be able to run up them smoothly. If you are trying to restrict movement from teams at the start then make it so there is a platform breaking up the stairs. most maps that use these type of stairs will have few of them so that a player can jump over them fairly easy.
This map contains collision points that teams will engage in some epic firefights, the map seems fairly balanced however I didnt play all game modes. I will write back again after doing so if I can.
The map gives you the feeling of being in some type of head quarters with offices and a few medium scale rooms and although there isnt too many flanking points or points to get the drop on someone I did find a few great spots to ambush the other team and an overlook that I was able to score a 5 kill off of from looking down at the enemies spawn exit.
I feel spawn camp is possible but you may find you get swarmed easy from it so when playing its best to let the team spawn and camp at a slight distance from spawn if your team is the dominate team.

Pro:
This map allows for some great firefights being a head on map. There is some nice features and structures within and isnt too much of an eyesore. narrow halls allow you to get easy kills and open rooms allow you to dodge gunfire when possible. spawn points seem fair and spawn camping on this map isnt easy. guns are balanced with many turns and not many very large rooms where snipers can camp.

Cons:
The Stairs need work and could make people rage. a few more decorations or block patterns might help make the map a bit more appealing to others. The map needs a little more flare without going crazy with decorations to make players lag.

Overall I enjoyed this map and think others will as well, good work bluehammer! looking forward to seeing any updates on this.

This massive war marks the end of all wars! The Blue Team strikes forward for the biggest carnage ever made only to free the prisoners held by the foolish and totalitarian Red Team! This is the Red Team's last stand as the Blue Team wastes no time calling down the artillery, causing everything to glow red, even the sky. Even though the vulcans can wreck the enemy lines from above the sniper pits from below can be problematic. The two skulls of doom face each other for the final battle as both sides have all the weapons high to strike! Which side will it be, the dictating, selfish, and totalitarian Red Team or the unforgiving and bloodthirsty Blue Team? One faction is ruled by a dictator while the other only consists of bloodthristy psychopaths! Choose your side!

Death Pit (continued)
So basically the area itself is completely symmetrical as it is pretty much a challenging variation to GraveBear's Lost Tomb. However, there would be red towers on the left side and blue towers on the right (they are only for decorative purposes). All teammates would spawn inside their respective skulls within the rectangular boundaries, which surrounds them with fire. Above or in front of the skulls would be the cannons for some defense, while the vulcan still is very easy to access, and the high grounds are the only means of attacking due to the sniper pits from below, even though it is possible to just walk through (it will be like a bridge). The skulls themselves would provide access to the network of tunnels, allowing some sneaky tactics and access to the sniper pits. This time around, the snipers would be firing from below and will have to defend, so that there would be no humiliation.

The reason why I'm thinking of collabing with the Blox Brix clan is because one, I am run out of map slots, and two, it will take a long time and money for me to do all that myself anyway.

I have some ideas for sequels too:

Network
It appears the Red Team has gone into hiding, but what's with all this network of tunnels?

As the name implies, it's a network of tunnels, but it's meant to be a fast-xp map. I have two layouts: a network of 1v1 matches or a maze just like the ones that farmers build so they can attract people. I have a precisely-specific layout for the maze one.

Snipers' Den
Get your snipers out and start firing at the other platform. Just rushing forward will only give you a bottomless pit.

The platforms are open but they're too far away for normal guns to gain many kills. This one is another fast-xp.

I have some other ideas too but I am having trouble trying to remember them all. This map was actually an entry for the Closed Beta Map contest but I never submitted it due to low fund so now, that I submitted the map on the server, I present you the RFF HeadQuarters!
Map Name: RFF HQ
Map Story: "The RFF decided to create a secret underground facility in the Desert below some abandoned ruins to conduct more experiments on new weapons. The facility was soon discovered by a gang of Mercenaries and, with the help of a culprit, the Mercenaries broke in and took half the facility. A battle is going to start soon between the RFF Repel Force and the Mercenary Side. Take up arms and fend off the intruders or get into the facility and get all the new weapons for yourself!"
Map Description: It is an underground facility map which takes place in the Desert. You start off the two sides of the factory and a fence is splitting your battleground. In order to get past, you need to either climp one of the towers on your side up or go through the underground tunnels found inside the base. If you get above the facility, you will get into an ancient Desert Ruin. The Base is invisible while out in the Desert and the tower's of the Ruins go up in the sky till the flag which is at the top. After you get to the flag, there is an escape route leading to the desert. There are some great spots but all of them have their weaknesses f.e. The turret house up in the desert has a hole on top where a grenade can be thrown and has limited view, the sniper spots on each side only view their battlefield etc.

BASIC INFO

Title: Mayan Rush
Modes: Team & Deathmatch
Created: 27-06-2012 to 30-06-2012 (4 days)
Bricks & Size: Over 26.000 bricks on 99 x 75

Special Thanks To:
JoeBelow and Exelz, for helping me out with some of the boring work, testing and keeping me company.

ADDITIONAL INFO

The map consists of a fictional Mayan pyramid, surrounded by a lot of trees and hills. The Blue Team spawns inside the pyramid, while the Red Team spawns around it, in the jungle.

But the map contains more than just a pyramid and trees, especially in the jungle. Everytime you see a flower, something useful is there. It could be an entrance to a tunnel or a cave, even a sniper tree, which might come in handy. It's also possible to do fence and tree running all around the pyramid. Inside the pyramid there is numerous ways to get up, down and around, but be careful when you decide to cross over in the middle of the pyramid. It's possible to run on the scattered bricks there, but if you take one wrong step, you're gone!

INGAME PICTURES


http://i.imgur.com/OWMLK.jpg

BASIC INFO

Title: Sky Dogs
Modes: Team
Created: 01-07-2012 to 02-07-2012 (2 days)
Bricks & Size: Almost 8.000 bricks on 97 x 60

Special Thanks To:
All the talkative people that literally filled out all the 8 slots several times during the creation of this map.

ADDITIONAL INFO

The map consists of 2 ships in the air (or water if you want). The Blue Team spawns at the Dutch ship and red Red Team spawns at the German ship.

There is no way to get over to the other ship and the range between them are quite far, therefore a sniper would be the best choice of weapon in this map. When you're out of ammo, there is only one way to get back in the game, and that is to walk the plank and die/drown like a pirate.
It's possible to be pretty much anywhere on the ships, in the sails, view post, deck and all the ship compartments. Besides the color, the ships are 100% identical and it's not possible to spawn kill in any way, which makes this map as balanced as it gets.

INGAME PICTURES


http://i.imgur.com/wC1pF.jpg

BASIC INFO

Title: Pac-Man
Modes: Team, Deathmatch & Capture The Flag
Created: 02-07-2012 to 03-07-2012 (2 days)
Bricks & Size: Over 31.500 bricks on 94 x 89

Special Thanks To:
Martoon for helping in with the finishing touches and testing the map with me.

ADDITIONAL INFO

This is my version of Nameco's popular game Pac-Man. The Blue Team spawns near the Pac-Man pixel art and the Red Team spawns near the Ghost pixel art, both equally close to the center of the map.

The structure of the map is also based on the original Pac-Man map from 1980. On the sides there is pixel art of Pac-Man, Ms. Pac-man, the ghosts and some of the things Pac-Man eat. The roof is a an exact 2D image of ground level, so if you ever feel lost, just look up. It's not possible to jump and see where other players are, but it is possible to boost another player onto the platforms and even climb 4 of the raised platforms on your own.

INGAME PICTURES


http://i.imgur.com/zgO8d.jpg

I have always had a thing for horror films, games, ect.... I loved the classic Silent Hill games for playstation and was inspired to make a map that had that same sorta feel to it. It isnt Silent Hill or a remake this is based on the idea of how the mood of the map makes players feel. I wanted to try and capture the feeling of being in a small town and it being completely empty (except players of course). I wanted the sky to be overcast with a fog to give it the sorta feeling that you are in a place of despair. The map is fairly simple in playing field, I treid to avoid multi floors and kept things easy so players didnt get lost. I mixed in the real-world buildings with the decaying look that Silent Hill has when you hear the Sirens. I hope you guys enjoy this map and want to thank all who helped me make it.

Now open: My first map for brick force. Based on a 747 with a cool green color scheme is "Hijack," a well-balanced, close-quarters map.
-Break the emergency glass and bring the battle out on the wings
-Jump out the cockpit windows and shoot your foes from the top, or snipe the enemy from the tail
-Sneak up on the other team's base using the cargo hold under the plane, or simply set up base on the turrets at the end of each wing

No matter what game mode you play, Hijack is a well-balanced map fit for all fighting styles:

Images:





Download and play 'Hijack' today, and look for other maps from ScarySheep, soon.

Story (Yes, there is one!):

Brick Co. has recently discovered a mysterious new gem with glass-like features in a small, hidden cave. Under careful study, the gem was found to be very flexible under extreme heat and had the strength of diamond after being heated and cooled. Brick Co. began to mine the mineral and call it a 'Weapon Gem'. They also found that, while under low pressure and exposed to limited radiation, the gem can transform into a cloth-like material with the same strength (hence, the equipment gem).

Unfortunately for Brick Co., the Red and Blue Alliances have discovered one of their mines, located near a massive tree. They soon build bases on either side of the mine's control field and attempt to take over the area.

Team Deathmatch: Both alliances have finished their bases and are attempting to claim control of the mine. Total war ensues the moment they meet, which ends up bringing some fast-paced heat all around the overground.

Capture the Flag: The tree contained altered traces of the valuable gem after its roots have been absorbing it for so long, so Brick Co. hollowed out the tree and stored the new substance within a flag (because they can) for later study. The traces of the gem turned out to be ridiculously toxic when tested on lab mice (R.I.P. Squeaks :'<), and both alliances just happened to have installed water pipes right before the information was discovered. Soon, the choke point moves into the tree as both factions attempt to poison each other's water supply.

Deathmatch: As the fight for the toxin continues, a grenade destroys the canister, causing the toxin to heat into a new, gaseous substance. The poison permeates the air and mines and causes soldiers everywhere to lose sense and begin to K.O. everyone else regardless of faction. The infantry still waiting to be deployed can only watch as the chaos spreads.

Defusion: The battle for control has yielded too many casualties, so the Red Alliance has decided to melt the crates of gems stockpiled within the caves using high-power explosives in order to create a super weapon. Of course, that won't be too easy with greedy Blue ready to defend the harvest for individual weapons.

Originally Posted by lzythe
No idea how the gravity works.
Oh ok, let me explain. You take the gravity up bricks and the gravity down bricks, fragile or non-fragile, whichever you prefer :P. You put them anywhere, and depending on the one you placed, the gravity for the ENTIRE MAP is altered. These cannot be moved, and the only way to change their effects is to destroy them. However, you can only destroy the fragile versions. So, if you want permanent set gravity, set a certain number of grav-bricks (blue is -10 gravity, orange is +10, the maximum and minimum are both at 100/-100) anywhere, either completely out of view or somewhere decorative, and there you go! Of course, you can also set 10 perma-orange/blue grav bricks, and then place fragile orange/blue around the map, which will basically decrease/increase the gravity when shot . They do not respawn though.

title: Distort: A unique map which you get to help design (if you want)!

posts.h:
So, I got this great idea of a map which I've been designing. Basically, it's this map where the Red Team spawns on a vaguely normal area, and then climb through this corkscrew which leads to the Blue Team's area, which is completely on its side! Since the Blue Team area will be significantly larger than the Red Team area, most of the fighting will take place on the walls of stuff. Here's a pic of the start of it, so you know what I'm going on about:


However, there's one aggravating catch to this: I have no idea what to actually build. So this is where you come in, if you want. Basically, think of some nice (but vaguely normal, and preferably not military) map things which I can put on my map. It has to be vaguely interesting, easily connectable, and sensible to fight on sideways.

If this is done right, this probably has a shot at MotW. I'm pretty excited about this, especially considering how cool the corkscrew turned out ^^.

Oh, and should this go in creative corner, or is this bit fine? I've seen other people post about this sorta thing here, so I figured...but I may be wrong :P.

You probably thought about this already, but here's a piece of advice : try to use optical illusions. Look at this picture I took a few hours ago, before knowing you made this topic :

One might think I'm inside a tunnel, but actually this is a pit and I was looking downwards. My point is, you could just build tilted houses and cars and it would work fine, but if you can mess with the player's mind and make them think "Am I looking at the right direction ?" then you know you made a great job. This particular illusion is probably impossible on a fully detailed map, but it's worth trying.

And since you don't know what to build, I'd say don't be classic. Don't build real-life houses, cars and roads, try to find a building design that would look realistic on another world, that matches your concept. Perhaps even a design that says "We're used to live on a twisted world" if that's where you want to go.

title: Knifeball -> American Football in soccer - style with knifes -> only teamwork wins

posts.h:
KNIFEBALL

First of all I want to thank you for reading this and I want to warn you! I come from Germany so if there are any grammar mistakes in this text, then it happend on purpose. If you play on the US Server, pls check out the US Map here

What is Knifeball?


Knifeball is a kind of a new game mode or maybe it feels like a new game mode... You have to fight with your Melee Weapons and you have to caputre the flag in the middle of the map.



If you have the flag, you should rush into the goal of the enemy. The other people without the flag should support him or defend him.


This is how you would play it without rules in a random lobby with random player.

You also could play Teamdeathmatch or what ever. But if you play it just like I told you, then I will garante you that you will have a lot of fun! And I recomment you to play it with friends or with your Clan while you are on Teamspeak and play against another Clan.

Facts of the Map
Builder: Kaylen
Game Modes: Teamdeath Match and CTF
Number of Bricks: about 15.000
Construction Time: I build it in one week. But I can't tell you the exact time.
Downloads: 859
Played: 5.361
Special Features: The map has a abyss right arround the main field. So every one has to stay inside of the field and you can't jump over it and you can't jump on the goal. Also not with help. Only one spawn point is near the goal, all the other spawnpoints are in one line, symmetric and fair placed! Only the Brick - God decides in wich one you will spawn!

More Pictures



Special Rule for Clan Matchs, Public Gaming and for Games with your Friends

If you want to have a fair and more funny game and, then I would like to tell you a special rule for that.

The Rule of Fairness!

Every one has to take the amour and Weapons! I think and I hope every one agreed with that

What your Team needs to win!

If you want to win with your team, then you have to play as a team! You have to be tactical and of course you also need skill! And trust me when I say that this map has so many tactics to play with!

Knifeball Clans and Matches


I really want to play this map with good and serious gamern. So it is more tactical or professional. Pls write down you Ingame Name under this topic if you want to become a part of a new Knifeball Clan. And there are other Clans who want to fight against my clan or if you want to be a listed Knifeball Clan, then also write it under this topic pls.

THANK YOU FOR READING AND I HOPE YOU WILL HAVE A LOT OF FUN WITH THIS MAP!

http://www.brick-force.com/forum/sho...ll=1#post92292

Most fun map I have worked on yet, there was no design or plan to this map. Most of the ideas just sorta fit together, had a few outside ideas from Benjodie, Armydog and IcyTea. SiNNiR and I just enjoyed the time spent building on this map, that started off to be just a small project turned into a massive planet-side map.

Back-Story:
Red team has uncovered some alien ruins on Planet QQ. An outpost was quickly set up to investigate the ruins. Several weeks have gone by and all communications were lost with the science team that was sent to the planet. The red federation dispatched a battle cruiser to see what has happened to their team, only to find the alien ruins were home to a race of hostile lifeforms. The Blue Aliens had eaten the science team but are hungry for more. Will the red team survive? or will they become the blue aliens next meal...

  • Join the Red Federation and fight to survive long enough till your battle cruiser can leave planet QQ
  • Join the Blue race of hostile aliens, angered their planet was invaded and hungry for blood.

How'd you do the cool overview of the map SiNNiR? It's a cool way to show off a map.

I did this in photoshop actually, and it was kinda neat how I did it.

1. I flew up above the map so that I could see it without the UI being in the way.
2. I cropped the screenshot in photoshops, then used the filter accent edges.
3. I cut out the map using magnetic lasso
4. for the color I made a new layer and from memory I made colored boxes over the map where the underground passages were
5. adjusted the layers opaque to make them transparent.
6. flatten image and save.

Hello everyone, I am not offering anything special here, but this is "Turf" I had been working on it since early beta and I finally had the time and attention span to do it. It took about 10 days or so. It might have gone faster if I wasn't limited by not having any wings or any other brick gun but the default. And boy, was it hard to make sure that every block on each side of the map is perfectly symmetrical. This map has a brick count of 32,067, which means it does take a little more time to load, so be patient! I do warn you, it is a very large map, and more targeted towards a large server rather than, say, four people. It comes with four modes, Death Match, Team Death Match, Defusion, and Capture The Flag.

Many have told me that the map is too open, and those without sniper rifles will not survive. To them, I say, use the building as cover. I have made sure that every building is connected in some way, so that even if you are a trooper, you can still gain access to the other side of the map without being sniped constantly.

Give the map a shot. There are so many places to go, you will have fun exploring while taking out the enemy. A new experience behind every corner. Below are snapshots of various places around the map.



Have fun!
-Zadd

Hello, Brickforce fans/players/moderators/admins/developers! The map here I made today took me around 13+ Hours straight of placing each brick manually and by myself. The idea for this map I got was from my favorite map in one of the best selling games, Counter-Strike Source. I added a few touches to it and modified it bit a teensy tiny bit. I added two elements to the game, Close-Quarters-Combat, and Long-Range, to appease to both crowds. There are 3 ways to the top of the tower, and only 3 no less, no more. Anyways, I hope you pick me for Map of the Week, and thank you Facebook BrickForce for showing me how to get here!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1: LADDER BY THE POOL
WHERE: BY THE POOL, WHICH IS IN FRONT OF THE HELICOPTER

Advantages: Straight to the top

Cons: Only one ladder, if one person gets stuck, they hold up the entire column below them
No cover, get killed from the top VERY easily
Chance of falling to your doom.

2: EMERGENCY ELEVATOR SHAFT
WHERE: BOTTOM FLOOR LOUNGE

Advantages: There are breakable boxes at the top, giving you time to get there without getting shot
Protection from outside
Straightforward to the top level
Two Ladders, which means 2 or more people can go

Cons: After breakable boxes are broke, it will just like the ladder by the pool, except with cover from the outside
Chance of falling to your doom

3: STAIRCASE TO VENT
WHERE&HOW: STAIRCASE, YOU'LL EVENTUALLY GET TO A DEAD-END WITH A LADDER GOING UP, THIS IS THE VENT
BREAK THE BOX (Most of my testing players skipped this part, and thought it was just dead-end)

Advantages: Safest way to get to the top level
Always guaranteed safety in the vents, unless someone comes from behind or throws a grenade.
2 Ladders, which means 2 or more people can go

Cons: To get to the vents, you must take the staircase which has entrance and exits to about 6 levels, all of which have RED spawns. 90% chance there will be a RED member there, so prepare for close quarters combat
Longer than doing the previous two options but safer.

Bonjour, fellow brick-people! I'm here to introduce my very first holiday themed map: DaX-mas! (Yes, I am aware of how terrible the pun is.) Let's get to describing it, shall we?

Story

After the writing of a long story,
A brick-man's life became very boring.
After searching for things to do,
he found that the holidays were coming too
"I'll make a map!" He cried in delight
And so he did, while drinking some Sprite
The work time was long, feelings were blue
Until the Brick realized that his map was soon due
And so he rushed, and with speed
he completed his map, and squealed with glee
And so with great stress, he pressed the small key
That would complete his work, and bring him much joy
Ho ho, there was no doubt that he was a happy boy
And so to the forums he rushed
and the music he hushed
to make a thread about is great work
And so here it is, the emblem of progress that makes the Brick-man smirk




About the map


DaX-mas is a map that has no real focus for a certain weapon type. Its medium size and many high positions can be great for snipers, but the indoor areas and cover spots make it suitable for close-ranged fighters as well. Whatever the heck you feel like using at the time. The main area of the map is mostly a flat surface that has several things constructed onto it; including Santa's workshop, and igloo, a church, a choir stand, a replica of the stable where Jesus was born (For the people with super-religious families, like mine) and even a place for kids to ask Santa for things for Christmas. But you won't want your kids on this battlefield! Also, who could forget the massive Christmas tree in the center?


Each team has their own three towers that can be accessed through ladders or stairs. (In Defusion, the blue side has bombs in these towers, and the CTF posts are also in the tallest areas.) Going inside of the largest building will allow you access to teleporters, one of which allows you to warp directly into enemy territory. Also, it's a fun idea to crowd up to the top of the buildings and go for one massive sniper war!


The final component in this map is the basement that resides below the main platform area. Completely protected from sniper cover, there are numerous ways to get inside including 2 entrances for both the red and blue team bases. This basement is houses a restaurant, a rock-climbing wall, a trap floor, and even a hockey rink for the athletic people! (If only Infernum had implemented slippery bricks...) The hockey rink also holds the flag in CTF, and due to it's complete flatness, it's sure to become a massive bloodbath during the CTF mode!


Available modes:
Team Deathmatch
Deathmatch
CTF
Defusion

**Hockey rink design credited to flametorch

title: Sector 2 (Defend or Invade the Research Station!)

posts.h:
The largest and most colorful of all the sectors, I present: Sector 2. As with most of my map threads, I'll toss in a story before describing the map itself:

--Story--


Sector 2, the second planet from the star Arya, is home to a facility which is devoted full to studying the weather patterns of different planets, as well as see how events in space (Such as space clouds and Supernovas) affects life on nearby Solar Systems. A team of 96 scientists work in this lab, and they pretty much live on in the research facility. This planet also houses a large number of weather and tracking gear, including a cross-galactic telecommunication satellite, a space activity monitor, and other items of the sort. The scientific gear cost a ridiculous amount of tokens to obtain, and the Ultanium building frame wasn't any cheaper.

It was all worth a fortune. And a group of criminals wanted it for themselves. Most of the weather junk was no use to them, but some things, like the communication satellite, would prove useful in future heists.

And so, the galactic outlaws took one of their 3 spaceships with several crew members, and drove it right into the Sector 2 Invention Lab, in a very kamikaze-like fashion. Two of the crew members survived the crash, and they called down their allies to invade. Using the newly invented teleportation device they beamed themselves directly into a research lab, and easily took control, killing 11 scientists in the process. Lucky for the rest of the team, most of the scientists there were familiar with several different types of weapons. They held the criminal squad back as the invaders got the rest of their team into the base. Having lost most of their numbers, the rest of the scientists take up arms to defend themselves against the criminal invaders. Will the criminals take Sector 2 and make a fortune off it? Or will the scientist team fend off the invaders and successfully defend their labs?


--About the Map--

Sector 2... is large. There's no doubt about that. But once you get past the lag and the occasional unfortunate miss on your jump, the entire place is one massive close-ranged battlefield.



Transport & Invention Lab

Each of the two teams gets one research lab and another large room. The Blue Team (Scientists) has the entire transportation department to themselves. Unfortunately... they only have the key cards to warp to their own research lab. The Red Team (Criminals) has taken the Invention Lab. Unfortunately for them, the kamikaze flight busted most of the machines there. Not the teleporter, though. That lets them teleport between their research lab and the invention room at will.

Storage, Power Plant, and Gravity Chambers
I don't have images of any of these rooms, and that's because that they're not very important, but worth mentioning. See those corner buildings in the overhead image? 2 of those are Storage, and 2 are Power plants. The storage, needless to say, is where the scientists put a lot of their scientific gear that's not in use. A lot of these are combustable though, so be careful while moving about the junk! The Powerplants each have 3 machine that harness the power of Energy Cells, which are basically giant batteries. Energy Cells are dangerous and are placed in very strong Ultanium containers, but some aren't kept properly, and will combust is shot at enough.

Now... the Gravity Chambers. To counter this planet's normally light gravity, scientists built Gravity chambers to balance it out. Gravity Chambers are hidden to keep some moron from screwing up the whole planet. However, if you discover a Gravity Chamber, you can trash the machines inside, increasing or decreasing the gravity by up to 60. If the odds of Gravity aren't in your favor, just find the opposite Chamber and equalize it. Anything done with Gravity in this map is reversible.
posts.t: Sector 2 (Defend or Invade the Research Station!)

posts.h:
Central Area and the Weather Tower


The Central Area is the largest room in the entire place, and consists of several separate levels. This is also where Gravity has its greatest effect. The Central Area is connected to every room in the entire place, excluding Power Plants, Gravity Chambers and Storage. There are a large number of Boosters and Ladders to help players move up and down to whatever level they want, but I'd personally recommend staying off the bottom unless you have -30 to -60 Gravity in effect. This is also where the most action takes place in CTF mode, AND is the only way to access the Weather Tower.

The Weather Tower is, of course, that big thing sitting on top of the central building. It is where the Flag Spawn is in CTF mode, and is also only accessible from the highest point in the Central Area. It's quite a climb, and quite a bloodbath if you have enough players in the room. Snipers, if you want, you can jump up to the rim of the tower and try to shoot down into the Transport Room and Invention Lab, but it's usually not worth it. But this is a good place to get a nice view of all the buildings down below. (I've also included windows in the top floor of the Research Labs to look at the Tower from the ground.

Available Modes:

Team Deathmatch
Deathmatch
CTF
Defusion

LAG WARNING:

Until the Lag issue is fixed, PLEASE REFRAIN from playing with too many people on Sector 2 to ensure minimal lag. Thank you.

Molten Mine
By Daxlfame


Story


Ashton is a humble mining town built at the base of a tall mountain, rumored to be filled with gold and diamonds. The caves were dangerous to mine though, because the mountain just happened to be an active volcano. But if there's profit, there's always someone willing to risk anything for it. Groups of brave miners and their families gathered at the base of the volcano. Soon enough, a town was built around the mine entrance and exports of gold and crystal made the miners rich beyond belief.

Of course, every good western story needs a bandit. A gang of bandits saw the defenseless town as an easy jackpot, and charged in to take their gold. The bandits quickly trapped all of Ashton's residents in the mine while they gathered the spoils and prepared to make their leave.

The mountain began rumbling, and people in the closest towns became worried about the fate of the small mining village. Some rushed to the mountain to see if any miners were trapped inside. And there were - but not because of cave-ins. People who got away managed to get their sheriff to the mines quickly enough before the top of the volcano burst, and molten lava began pouring down its sides.

With the clock against them, will the sheriff and his gang be able to fight off the bandits before they're buried by rock and ash? Or will the thieves make a quick escape and leave the townspeople in a deathtrap inside the mountains?

About the Map


MoltenMine is just what you'd expect - a mine with lava. There are two main parts to the map - the town on a cliff on the mountain side, (Serves as base for the Blue Team - A.K.A. Sheriff and gang) and the fiery tunnels inside. (Red Team Base - Bandits)

Overall, the map is actually pretty small despite its appearance. The cramped tunnels make any shotgun-user feel at home. On the outside, there still isn't much space, though it's possible to scale buildings and the side of the mountain if you feel like sniping. Otherwise, using a Long-category weapon is not recommended.

Upon entering from any of two openings to the mine, (Or a third semi-secret one) you'll come into a central area with a large crystal in the center - this is where a good amount of the fighting takes place. There are two "layers" to this part - a top half consisting of a rocky ledge and several wooden bridges, and a hot, fiery, lava pool floor. If you continue to go deeper, there's a small, gold-filled chamber where miners sleep, and then a rich diamond mine on the opposite side. (The diamond mine is stuffed will unused mining TNT that can be used to blow up someone hiding under cover.) Each of these sections has two tunnels that lead to the central area - one on the top half of the center, and one that comes in on the bottom. There's also a harder-to-find tunnel that connects both of these areas.

You'll always find somewhere to take cover in this map (Though that may not protect you from grenades - which are extremely effective in the cramped areas), and the optimal weapons are Mediums and Heavies, particularly weapons that trade accuracy for high power. My personal favorite gamemodes for this map (So far) are Deathmatch (Especially with only Secondaries enabled) and Defusion.

Supported Modes:
Team Deathmatch
Deathmatch
Capture the Flag
Defusion
Zombie
